post.description: Initiate a payment for any GTBank Partner API service (creditwallet, debitwallet, banktrf, ...). A transaction record is persisted before the call so the outcome is always traceable. The transaction is asynchronous: GTBank normally answers PENDING and posts the final result to the callback URL. If the GTBank call times out or fails without a definitive answer, the API automatically reconciles via /services/status before responding — a recovered outcome is flagged with RecoveredAfterTimeout, and a reused PartnerTransId with DuplicatePartnerTransId.

post.description: GTBank Partner API sends transaction status updates asynchronously to this endpoint — confirmed to arrive WITHOUT a SecureHash. The callback is treated as a notification only: the authoritative status is pulled from GTBank /services/status and persisted. An unsigned or forged callback can therefore never mark a transaction completed. Responds 200 once reconciled; 400 only when PartnerTransId is missing or nothing could be verified (GTBank will retry).

info.title: Lidapay API
info.description:
A secure and scalable API designed to power the Lidapay ecosystem, providing a seamless experience for users across various platforms.
  Powered by Advansis Technologies.

  [Base URL](https://api.advansistechnologies.com/)
  [API Documentation](https://api.advansistechnologies.com/api-doc)

  Lidapay API provides services for airtime, mobile money and internet bundle across networks locally and internationally.

  Payments: **Advansis Pay** (ExpressPay hosted checkout — cards + mobile money) and
  **GTPay** (GTBank Partner API — bank transfers, wallet credit/debit).

  Web/e-commerce and partner-app integration: per-transaction `returnUrl` /
  `webhookUrl` / `webhookSecret` on the initiate call — see
  docs/ADVANSISPAY_WEB_INTEGRATION.md and docs/GTPAY_PRODUCTION_INTEGRATION.md.

  Lead Developer: Hanson Peprah
  Send email to support.it@advansistechnologies.com

tags.name: Advansis Money
tags.description: ExpressPay hosted checkout (cards + mobile money). POST /initiate-payment returns a checkoutUrl + token + order-id; optional per-transaction returnUrl / webhookUrl / webhookSecret drive the post-payment browser redirect (https, app scheme, or lidapay:// default) and a signed server-to-server webhook. Verify final state via POST /query-transaction.

tags.name: GTPay
tags.description: GTBank Partner API — banktrf (GIP bank transfer), creditwallet, debitwallet, name/balance queries, bank list. Transactions are async: pay returns PENDING, the final outcome arrives at POST /callback (unsigned — reconciled via /services/status) or POST /status. PartnerTransId is the idempotency key; a 504 PAYMENT_STATUS_UNKNOWN must be status-checked before any retry.

tags.name: Shop
tags.description: Product catalog, cart, checkout and order tracking. Flow: browse GET /api/v1/shop/products & /categories → sync items to the server cart (POST /cart/add, PUT /cart/update) → POST /checkout creates the order → the app initiates payment via /api/v1/gtpay/pay or /api/v1/advansispay/initiate-payment → track via GET /orders/{id}/tracking. Product prices already include the 10% partner commission; when discountPrice > 0 it is the final payable price.

network.description: Network code (0-9) 1: AirtelTigo, 4: MTN, 5: Telecel, 6: Telecel, 7: Glo, 8: Expresso, 9: Busy

paymentMethod.description: Payment method: momo, card, or wallet

deliveryFee.description: Delivery fee in GHS. If omitted, system calculates.

ServiceName.description: Service code used in pay/query calls

Data.description: List of available services (e.g. creditwallet, debitwallet, banktrf)

PartnerTransId.description: Unique numeric transaction reference (max 20 chars). Auto-generated when omitted.

ServiceName.description: Service name being queried, e.g. 'services' (list services), 'balance' (account balance), or a service found in the /services/query response (e.g. 'creditwallet', 'banktrf', 'airtime').

ServiceNumber.description: Account/service identifier being verified, e.g. bank account number, mobile money number, wallet number, or student ID.

SecondaryServiceNumber.description: Required for services that need extra verification data, e.g. bank branch/sort code for banktrf.

AccountInfo.description: Account holder name / service provider info

formData.description: Key/value pairs such as AccountNumber and AvailableBalance for balance queries

ServiceName.description: Service being paid for, found in the response of the /services/query 'services' request.

ServiceNumber.description: The account number / identifier of the service being paid.

SecondaryServiceNumber.description: Required for specific services that need extra data for payment. For Bank Transfer (GIP): SecondaryServiceNumber is the GIP bank code from the banks list. For Bank Transfer (NRT): use the BOG sort code of the receiving bank.

Amount.description: Amount to be paid. Send as a numeric string to preserve exact precision in the SecureHash (e.g. "10.00" not 10.0).

Remarks.description: Narration/Remarks of the transaction. Required by GTBank API.

PaidBy.description: Name of person making the transaction. Required by GTBank API.

PayeeName.description: Name of person receiving the transaction.

PaymentMethod.description: Payment method; required for some services e.g. 'credit_account'.

SenderCountry.description: Country where the sender is initiating the remittance transaction. Example: 'USA'. For non-remittance users this field can be left blank.

SenderCurrency.description: Currency used by the sender, optionally including the transaction amount. Example: 'USD 13015.49'. For non-remittance users this field is optional.

Address.description: Sender's residential or origin address. Example: 'XYZ ABC'. For non-remittance users this field can be omitted.

Purpose.description: Purpose or reason for the remittance transaction. Examples: 'Remittance', 'Family Support', 'Savings'. For non-remittance users this field is optional.

PartnerTransId.description: Unique numeric transaction reference (max 20 chars). Auto-generated when omitted.

userId.description: Lidapay user ID the payment belongs to — persisted on the transaction record for history.

userName.description: Lidapay username for the transaction record. Defaults to PaidBy.

shopOrderNumber.description: Shop order number (e.g. LPS260912482913) returned by POST /api/v1/shop/checkout. When set, the final GTBank outcome (from the pay response, /status query or async callback) automatically marks the matching shop order paid or failed. As a fallback the order number is also extracted from ServiceDetails.Remarks.

CallbackURL.description: URL GTBank will POST the final transaction status to. Defaults to GT_CALLBACK_URL.

RecoveredAfterTimeout.description: Present when /services/pay timed out or returned no definitive answer and the outcome was recovered via /services/status.

DuplicatePartnerTransId.description: Present when GTBank reported the PartnerTransId already exists; the returned status belongs to the original transaction.

PartnerTransId.description: The PartnerTransId used when the original /services/pay call was made.

Data.description: Optional extra data returned by GTBank

BankCode.description: GIP bank code — use as SecondaryServiceNumber for banktrf (GIP)

NrtActive.description: Whether NRT (sort-code) transfers are active for this bank

IsActive.description: Whether the bank is active on the Partner API

Data.description: List of supported banks for bank transfer

hashVerified.description: Whether the callback SecureHash verified. When false, the transaction was still reconciled via an authoritative GTBank status query.
